REGISTRATION (SINDH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
REGISTRATION (SINDH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to amend the
Registration Act, 1908, in its application to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 28th December, 1996]
No.S.Legis.1(7)/96, dated 28‑12‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Registration (Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 17 of Act XVI of 1908

REGISTRATION (SINDH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
REGISTRATION (SINDH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance to amend the
Registration Act, 1908, in its application to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 28th December, 1996]
No.S.Legis.1(7)/96, dated 28‑12‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 17 of
Act XVI of 1908.‑‑‑In the Registration Act, 1908, in its
application to the Province of Sindh, in section 17, after clause(e)., the following
shall be added:‑‑
"(f) Power
of attorney when authorising the attorney to sell any immovable
property.".
